DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis/Bladder Pain Syndrome.

The urinalysis is negative for infection, and cystoscopy shows normal mucosa, which effectively rules out a urinary tract infection and visible bladder pathology. Given your chronic bladder pain relieved by voiding, frequency, nocturia, and recent dyspareunia in the absence of infection, the clinical picture strongly points to Interstitial Cystitis.
